Project Kick-Off.description: The formal start of the onboarding, bringing together all key stakeholders to introduce the project team, walk through the onboarding plan and timeline, and establish ways of working.
Project Kick-Off.attendees:
Executive Sponsor
Project Manager
Marketing Lead
Marketing End-User(s)
Technical Lead
Project Kick-Off.agendaOutcomes:
Introductions across both teams and role assignments
Finalise onboarding scope
Confirm meeting cadence and communication channels
Agree on immediate next steps and week 1 actions

Platform Governance & Security.description: A guided walkthrough of the Braze dashboard combined with a working session on platform governance setup. This equips the team to navigate Braze confidently and makes the key foundational decisions around users, permissions, workspaces, and governance controls.
Platform Governance & Security.attendees:
Project Manager
Braze Admin
Marketing Lead
Marketing End-User(s)
Technical Lead
Engineers (Optional)
IT/Security
Platform Governance & Security.agendaOutcomes:
Guided tour of the Braze dashboard and core navigation
Configure SSO and automated user provisioning approach
Plan workspace structure and user permissions model
Discuss Teams, tagging strategy, and frequency capping approach
Assign owners for each governance task
Platform Governance & Security.relatedTasks:
Add Dashboard Users
Manage Braze User Permissions
Setup Teams (Optional)
Setup SAML, Single Sign-On (SSO) & Automated User Provisioning
Configure Braze Workspaces
Establish a Global Tagging Strategy
Configure Frequency Capping Rules

Setup Governance & Security.description: A guided walkthrough of the Braze dashboard combined with a working session on platform governance setup. This equips the team to navigate Braze confidently and makes the key foundational decisions around users, permissions, workspaces, and governance controls.
Setup Governance & Security.attendees:
Project Manager
Braze Admin
Marketing Lead
Marketing End-User(s)
Technical Lead
Engineers (Optional)
IT/Security
Setup Governance & Security.agendaOutcomes:
Guided tour of the Braze dashboard and core navigation
Configure SSO and automated user provisioning approach
Plan workspace structure and user permissions model
Discuss Teams, tagging strategy, and frequency capping approach
Assign owners for each governance task
Setup Governance & Security.relatedTasks:

Manage Braze User Permissions
Setup Teams (Optional)
Setup SAML, Single Sign-On (SSO) & Automated User Provisioning
Configure Braze Workspaces
Establish a Global Tagging Strategy
Configure Frequency Capping Rules

Weekly Project Management Alignment Call.description: A recurring standing meeting throughout the onboarding to track progress against the plan, surface blockers, and keep momentum.
Weekly Project Management Alignment Call.attendees:
Project Manager
Marketing Lead
Marketing End-User(s)
Technical Lead
Engineers (Optional)
Weekly Project Management Alignment Call.agendaOutcomes:
Review progress against the plan since last sync
Surface and assign owners to any blockers or risks
Confirm priorities and actions for the coming week
Open questions and support needs

Campaign & Data Planning Workshops.description: A series of collaborative working sessions to define the P1/P2/P3 campaign roadmap and, from it, the custom data strategy needed to power those campaigns. These sessions are the strategic foundation for the technical and channel work that follows.
Campaign & Data Planning Workshops.attendees:
Project Manager
Marketing Lead
Marketing End-User(s)
Technical Lead
Engineers (Optional)
Campaign & Data Planning Workshops.agendaOutcomes:
Audit existing campaigns and identify migration candidates
Define net new campaigns and journeys for Braze
Prioritise into P1/P2/P3 with rationale
Map the data (attributes, events, properties) each campaign requires
Document the data specification for engineering

Tech Overview.description: A discovery session to review your architecture diagrams, build a deeper understanding of your tech stack, and confirm the technical scope and timelines for the integration.
Tech Overview.attendees:
Project Manager
Marketing Lead
Engineering / Technical Lead
Front/Back End Engineer(s) 
Data / Analytics Team,
Tech Overview.agendaOutcomes:
Review technical survey and architecture diagrams
Gain a deeper understanding of the tech stack
Confirm technical scope and timelines

SDK Deep Dive.description: A focused deep dive into the SDK integration, walking through the full scope of what the SDK enables, from user data collection through to the channels and features it powers.
SDK Deep Dive.attendees:
Project Manager
Marketing Lead
Engineering / Technical Lead
Front End Engineer(s)
SDK Deep Dive.agendaOutcomes:
Walkthrough of the SDK integration
Discuss user profile lifecycle & user data collection
Discuss configuration of channels including push, in-app messages, content cards and banners
Agree on SDK implementation approach and testing
SDK Deep Dive.relatedTasks: SDK Integration (iOS, Android, Web), Configure Push Notifications, Set Up In-App Messages, Set Up Content Cards

API Deep Dive.description: A deep dive focused on the structure of REST API calls, transactional messaging, data payloads, and how backend systems will send data to and trigger messages from Braze.
API Deep Dive.attendees:
Project Manager
Marketing Lead
Engineering / Technical Lead
Back End Engineer(s)
API Deep Dive.agendaOutcomes:
Review REST API endpoints relevant to the use cases
Walk through payload structure and identifier mapping
Discuss rate limits, batching, and error handling
Confirm which triggers and data flows are server-side
Agree on API implementation approach and testing

Reporting & Analytics.description: An optional session to define your reporting and analytics needs, ensuring the right dashboards, reports, and data exports are set up to measure success from go-live.
Reporting & Analytics.attendees:
Project Manager
Marketing Lead
Engineering / Technical Lead
Back End Engineer(s) 
Data / Analytics Team
Reporting & Analytics.agendaOutcomes:
Review out-of-the-box reporting and Dashboard Builder capabilities
Discuss conversion events and how success is measured
Determine any data export needs (Currents, Snowflake)
Agree on reporting structure and owners

QA & Testing.description: An optional session to walk your team through the QA resources available to them ahead of go-live, including the Braze production readiness guide and the QA features built into the dashboard.
QA & Testing.attendees:
Project Manager
Marketing Lead
Engineering / Technical Lead
Front/Back End Engineer(s) 
QA Specialist (Optional)
QA & Testing.agendaOutcomes:
Walk through the Braze production readiness guide
Review the QA features available in the dashboard
Discuss recommended testing approaches and best practices

Email Discovery Workshop.description: This session covers the technical setup of sending domains and authentication as well as best practices for deliverability and IP Warming.
Email Discovery Workshop.attendees:
Project Manager
Marketing Lead
Marketing End-User(s)
Email Discovery Workshop.agendaOutcomes:
Walk through sending domain and authentication setup (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)
Discuss subdomain strategy and IP structure
Begin planning the IP Warming
Review email deliverability best practices
Email Discovery Workshop.relatedTasks:
Configure Sending Domains (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)
Develop IP Warming Plan
Build Email Templates
Configure Unsubscribe & Preference Centre

Pre IP Warming Workshop.description: A checkpoint session to confirm everything is in place before IP warming begins, including the warming plan, the engagement attribute for prioritising engaged users, and the campaigns needed to run the warming schedule.
Pre IP Warming Workshop.attendees:
Project Manager
Marketing Lead
Marketing End-User(s)
Pre IP Warming Workshop.agendaOutcomes:
Review and confirm the IP warming plan and schedule
Confirm segmentation for IP warming
Decide automated vs manual warming approach
Confirm warming campaigns and audiences are ready
Agree on monitoring approach and escalation criteria
Pre IP Warming Workshop.relatedTasks:
Execute IP Warming (Automated)
Execute IP Warming (Manual)

SMS Discovery Workshop.description: A session to walk you through SMS compliance and best practices and the SMS provisioning process and requirements
SMS Discovery Workshop.attendees:
Project Manager
Marketing Lead
Marketing End-User(s)
Legal / Compliance (Optional)
SMS Discovery Workshop.agendaOutcomes:
Determine number strategy (long code, short code, or migration)
Kick off provisioning and regulatory registration (10DLC, etc.)
Discuss subscription groups and opt-in/opt-out approach
Review quiet hours and compliance requirements
Confirm timelines given carrier lead times
SMS Discovery Workshop.relatedTasks:
Set Up Long Code
Set Up Short Code
Migrate Codes from Existing Provider
Configure Opt-In & Opt-Out Keywords
Build SMS Messages
Set Up Quiet Hours

SMS Enablement.description: A follow-up session once provisioning is progressing, focused on building the SMS messages, finalising keyword and compliance configuration, and preparing for launch, including migration cutover if applicable.
SMS Enablement.attendees:
Project Manager
Marketing Lead
Marketing End-User(s)
Legal / Compliance (Optional)
SMS Enablement.agendaOutcomes:
Review SMS messages for P1 campaigns
Finalise opt-in/opt-out keyword configuration and responses
Confirm quiet hours settings
Plan migration cutover (if migrating)
Review testing approach
SMS Enablement.relatedTasks:
Set Up Long Code
Set Up Short Code
Migrate Codes from Existing Provider
Configure Opt-In & Opt-Out Keywords
Build SMS Messages
Set Up Quiet Hours

WhatsApp Discovery Workshop.description: A session to initiate the WhatsApp channel workstream, focussed on the account setup and verification tasks, including phone number procurement and the Meta Business Account requirements.
WhatsApp Discovery Workshop.attendees:
Project Manager
Marketing Lead
Marketing End-User(s)
Meta Business Admin
Legal / Compliance (Optional)
WhatsApp Discovery Workshop.agendaOutcomes:
Walk through phone number requirements and procurement options
Understand the Meta Business Account and WABA structure
Kick off business verification
Discuss opt-in strategy and content rules
WhatsApp Discovery Workshop.relatedTasks:
Procure WhatsApp Phone Number
WhatsApp Business Account Setup & Verification
Configure Opt-In & Opt-Out

WABA Process Walkthrough.description: A follow-up session once your account is set up and verified, focused on building message templates, configuring opt-in/opt-out, and optionally setting up WhatsApp Flows ahead of launch.
WABA Process Walkthrough.attendees:
Project Manager
Marketing Lead
Marketing End-User(s)
WABA Process Walkthrough.agendaOutcomes:
Build and submit message templates for Meta approval
Configure opt-in collection and opt-out handling
Review subscription group management approach
Plan WhatsApp Flows if in scope
WABA Process Walkthrough.relatedTasks:
Set Up WhatsApp Message Templates
Configure Opt-In & Opt-Out
Set Up WhatsApp Flows
